001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.rulecmd;
002
003import java.awt.Color;
004import java.util.ArrayList;
005import java.util.List;
006import java.util.Map;
007
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.InteractionDialogAPI;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.rules.MemoryAPI;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc.Token;
011
012public class SetTooltipHighlightColors extends BaseCommandPlugin {
013
014        public boolean execute(String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
015                if (dialog == null) return false;
016                
017                String option = params.get(0).string;
018                List<Color> colors = new ArrayList<Color>();
019                for (int i = 1; i < params.size(); i++) {
020                        Color color = params.get(i).getColor(memoryMap);
021                        colors.add(color);
022                }
023        
024                dialog.getOptionPanel().setTooltipHighlightColors(option, colors.toArray(new Color[0]));
025                return true;
026        }
027
028}
